result.reason: The clause reaches the preferred limits for CGL, E&O, and conditional cyber/privacy coverage and requires certificates on request, but it omits workers’ compensation coverage as required by law. It also unnecessarily requires all coverage to continue for one year after termination, which is not in the playbook and is particularly awkward for occurrence-based CGL coverage. Placement after the execution language is structurally poor. The unrelated bankruptcy and integration provisions remain substantively unchanged, and the margin comment does not cure the operative omission.
